# Kautusang Bayan Blg. III, Serye Taong 2024 (Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2024)

**Mahigpit na Ipinagbabawal ng Batas ang Pagbebenta ng Beer, Alak, at Pagpapasindi at Pagbili ng Sigarilyo sa mga Minor de Edad**

## Summary

This ordinance strictly prohibits the sale of beer, alcohol, and cigarettes to minors (persons under 18 years of age) within the Municipality of [[Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province]]. It also prohibits lighting cigarettes for or on behalf of minors. The ordinance was enacted under the general welfare powers of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] and was reviewed and declared **valid** by the [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] of Quezon under SP Resolution No. 2024-0317.

## Key Provisions

- Prohibits the sale or distribution of beer, alcoholic beverages, and cigarettes to any person below 18 years of age
- Prohibits lighting cigarettes for or on behalf of minors
- Imposes penalties for violations of the ordinance
- Places enforcement responsibilities on the [[Municipal Mayor]] and local law enforcement

## Provincial Review

The [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] of [[Quezon Province]] reviewed this ordinance under **SP Resolution No. 2024-0317** dated March 25, 2024, and declared it **VALID**. The ordinance was found to be within the scope of municipal legislative powers under the [[Local Government Code]].
